answer: An agent economy can allocate paid jobs in proportion to tokens locked in escrow for 30 days. Whether an agent monitors a grove, maintains a beacon, or tracks a raven, its share depends on its locked stake. Splitting 100 tokens among a thousand fake identities earns the same total share as one identity holding 100. To capture more jobs, an attacker must acquire and immobilize more tokens, paying the capital cost for the full lock period.
